value.rationale: Quantifies a structural mesh-alignment loss of smoothing in a recently proposed positive wide-stencil method: a k² or 2k² dimensional eigenvalue-one subspace despite elliptic coercivity, exact parity-dependent conditioning and a low-relative-frequency O(1) error on a precisely motivated wavelength. It distinguishes fixed-smooth convergence from nonuniform mesoscale response and can inform mesh selection and iterative solver diagnostics.
